Name: WoWDeck
Author: Behmen
Description: Bidirectional World of Warcraft Forever integration for Elgato Stream Deck via optical telemetry and zero-collision dynamic bindings for 116 slots (Action Bars 1-8, Stance Bar, Pet Bar).

Actions.Name: WoW Action Slot
Actions.Tooltip: Displays live spell icon, cooldown, mana/range status, and stacks for all 116 WoW Slots (Action Bars 1-8, Stance Bar 1-10, Pet Bar 1-10) and triggers them with zero-collision dynamic bindings.
